C1266.title: Man-in-the-Middle Attack in the Kris Wu Incident
C1266.summary: Starting in June 2021, suspect Liu used online hype information, obtained some relationship details, and separately impersonated Du Meizhu and Kris Wu lawyer to communicate and induce transfers, demanding 3 million yuan in settlement compensation and defrauding 180,000 yuan. The process can be used as a teaching analogy for man-in-the-middle attacks because identity impersonation, information asymmetry, and two-sided deception created a trust hijacking effect similar to a middleman position, but it should not be stated as police-confirmed network interception and modification of real communications.
